_comment: Maps a component's display name (exactly as it appears in components/ethwan-router-components.json) to where its interface data lives. Two forms: a plain string is the cpokuru repo slug, defaulting to a file named dml.json in it; an object {"repo": "...", "file": "..."} lets you point at any filename. Add a line per component as its data file goes up -- no code changes needed either way.
